items.t: What Investors Got Wrong About Hertz Global Before A 71% Slide
items.sum: If you had looked at Hertz Global on 1 January 2026 and decided to sit it out, the missed opportunity was not upside but pain. For Hertz Global shareholders, the loss from the start of the year was 71.3%, including dividends. items.t: HTZ Q3 2026 deep dive: U.S. gains offset by cost and international pressures
items.sum: Global car rental company Hertz (NASDAQ:HTZ) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 5.6% year on year to $2.62 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.14 per share was 43.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
